segments.an9.14:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā samiddhi yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ samiddhiṃ āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca –
segments.an9.14:11.1: “‘Kimārammaṇā, samiddhi, purisassa saṅkappavitakkā uppajjantī’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno ‘nāmarūpārammaṇā, bhante’ti vadesi.
segments.an9.14:11.2: ‘Te pana, samiddhi, kva nānattaṃ gacchantī’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno ‘dhātūsu, bhante’ti vadesi.
segments.an9.14:11.3: ‘Te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamudayā’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno ‘phassasamudayā, bhante’ti vadesi.
segments.an9.14:11.4: ‘Te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamosaraṇā’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno ‘vedanāsamosaraṇā, bhante’ti vadesi.
segments.an9.14:11.5: ‘Te pana, samiddhi, kiṃpamukhā’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno ‘samādhippamukhā, bhante’ti vadesi.
segments.an9.14:11.6: ‘Te pana, samiddhi, kiṃadhipateyyā’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno ‘satādhipateyyā, bhante’ti vadesi.
segments.an9.14:11.7: ‘Te pana, samiddhi, kiṃuttarā’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno ‘paññuttarā, bhante’ti vadesi.
segments.an9.14:11.8: ‘Te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsārā’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno ‘vimuttisārā, bhante’ti vadesi.
segments.an9.14:11.9: ‘Te pana, samiddhi, kiṃogadhā’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno ‘amatogadhā, bhante’ti vadesi.
segments.an9.14:11.11: Sādhu kho tvaṃ, samiddhi, puṭṭho [pañhaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] puṭṭho vissajjesi, tena ca mā maññī”ti.

lines: Iminā cattāro arūpakkhandhā bhūtupādāyarūpañca vitakkānaṃ paccayoti dasseti.
Kva nānattaṃ gacchantīti kasmiṃ ṭhāne nānāsabhāvataṃ vemattaṃ gacchanti.
Tattha pubbaṅgamaṭṭhena jeṭṭhakaṭṭhena vā samādhi pamukhaṃ etesanti samādhippamukhā.
Ārammaṇavasena amataṃ nibbānaṃ ogāhitvā tattha patiṭṭhitāti amatogadhā.
Tena ca mā maññīti tena vissajjanena “ahaṃ aggasāvakena pucchite pañhe vissajjesin”ti mā mānaṃ vā dappaṃ vā akāsi.
Catutthe samiddhīti therassa kira attabhāvo samiddho abhirūpo pāsādiko, tasmā samiddhītveva saṅkhāto.
